subject: Dringend: Polizze Nr. 2044001194 / X712.261-2 – 1120 Wien, Schallergasse 35
text:
Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,

ich bin der zuständige Verwalter / Vertreter der neuen Eigentümerseite der Liegenschaft 1120 Wien, Schallergasse 35.

Uns liegt Ihr Schreiben vom 20.05.2026 zur Polizze Nr. 2044001194 / bisherige Polizze Nr. X712.261-2 vor.
Darin wird eine offene Prämie in Höhe von EUR 1.591,81 zuzüglich Mahnspesen EUR 10,00 ausgewiesen und darauf hingewiesen, dass der Versicherungsschutz gefährdet sein kann.

Ich ersuche Sie daher dringend um schriftliche Bestätigung folgender Punkte:

  1.    ob die Prämie von EUR 1.591,81 zuzüglich EUR 10,00 aktuell noch offen ist;
  2.    auf welches Konto die Zahlung zu leisten ist und welche Zahlungsreferenz anzugeben ist;
  3.    ob der Versicherungsschutz derzeit noch aufrecht ist;
  4.    ob durch sofortige Zahlung eine Unterbrechung oder Gefährdung des Versicherungsschutzes vermieden wird;
  5.    welche Unterlagen Sie für die Aktualisierung des Versicherungsnehmers bzw. der zuständigen Verwaltung benötigen.

Bitte senden Sie mir außerdem alle bei Ihnen aktuell gespeicherten Vertragsdaten zur Liegenschaft 1120 Wien, Schallergasse 35, damit die Verwaltung und die Kontaktdaten ordnungsgemäß aktualisiert werden können.

Aufgrund der Dringlichkeit ersuche ich um Rückmeldung so schnell wie moglich.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Cosmin Covaciu

QUAD GmbH
Distribution + Consulting
Solutions for your success.
QUAD GmbH. 
Future included.
QUAD GmbH
The Company
QUAD GmbH in Lippstadt, North Rhine-Westphalia, 
started over 30 years ago with the “POS techno-
logy - point of sale” division as a distributor and 
consulting platform for POS systems, kiosk solutions, 
barcode technology, label printing and mobile data 
collection for single-user and cross-border installati-
ons in Europe.
Our claim to always be at the cutting edge of tech-
nology, development and service is reflected in our 
trained employees, innovative services in cooperati-
on with our business partners and our own concepts 
for project support at the end customer. As a so-cal-
led full-range supplier with unrivaled service perfor-
mance, our company is one of the first in its sector.
We advise and support your projects from product
product selection through to installation. We are at 
your disposal with our know-how in the entire retail, 
gastronomy, food sector, industrial and OEM appli-
cations.With a view to future security, we find the best pro-
duct the best product from the renowned market 
leaders for your market leaders for your budget.
The constantly growing range of technologies in 
retail and hospitality are among the company‘s core 
competencies, which is why this product area is now 
presented under “Business Solutions”.
The “Advanced Systems” division with OEM products 
has been successfully positioning itself worldwide 
for many years as a supplier of scanning and RFID 
modules for installation in systems and products with 
additional offices in France, Italy and the UK.
With its expertise in the Auto-ID environment, the 
“ITL - Industry/Transport/Logistics” team expands the 
“Advanced Systems” division with production-ready 
IT and Auto-ID solutions for the automotive and 
accessories sectors as an additional growth driver for 
the consulting-oriented distributor. Founded in 1991,
based in Lippstadt (NRW)over 50 employees in
four countriesSales offices in 
Germany, England,
France & Italy
“This new division helps our customers to gain an 
overview of QUAD‘s rapidly growing product range, 
to focus on the areas of individual interest and thus 
to benefit even more intensively from the respective 
expertise of the teams.”
Manfred Dobler
Sales Director Advanced Systems“We were able to record a new all-time record year 
in 2024 and the adjusted structure helps us to serve 
the increasing demand even better with efficiency 
and flexibility. The intensive collaboration between 
the different product teams and the resulting consul-
ting expertise remains one of our particular advan-
tages - across all product areas.”
Karsten Hinners
Sales Director Business Solutions
QUAD GmbH
Our Development

QUAD GmbH
Our Motivation
Our suppliers are an important part of our success. 
For this reason, QUAD GmbH works exclusively 
with solid technology providers who offer us and our 
customers a secure future. Our suppliers are “hand-
picked” and represent market-leading manufacturers 
in the international POS, OEM and Auto-ID industry. 
 
QUAD GmbH is an independent company - so we 
can afford to buy only the best on the market without 
the influence of manufacturers. The selection and 
reputation of our partner suppliers meet this require-
ment. Through intensive cooperation with the ma-
nufacturers on a sales and technical level, we have the information basis for a well-founded, reliable 
product selection. 
 
We are convinced of the products that make it into 
our range and can represent them accordingly. We 
provide the arguments you need for your day-to-day 
business and are happy to pass on this commitment.  
 
We provide the good arguments for your daily busi-
ness business - with commitment.

QUAD GmbH
Our Capacity
By expanding our warehouse space, we are streng-
thening our ability to meet individual customer 
requirements even more efficiently and reliably. The 
additional storage space gives us the opportunity to 
meet the increasing demands of modern logistics 
and to react flexibly to market developments.  
 
With state-of-the-art warehouse technology, intelli-
gent inventory management and a dedicated team 
on site, we ensure that all processes run smoothly.
 
Distribution warehouse  
The central hub for efficient coordination & shipping. Procurement warehouse  
Scalable and perfectly tailored to large projects and 
just-in-time deliveries.
 
Staging center  
For preloads and assembly - everything is ready 
before it goes to you. 
 
Expansion of storage capacity in Lippstadt - more 
flexibility for your logistics!

QUAD GmbH
Our Product Portfolio
Supply of the specialized trade  
 
Software house/VAR  
The implementation of all hardware in the 
existing solution of the partner is in the 
foreground. QUAD GmbH‘s hardware support 
enables our customers to achieve the optimum 
synthesis of software and hardware expertise. 
With our partner concept, we are able to offer 
our customers over 80 professional industry 
solutions. 
 
Cash register retailers/office retailers  
This customer group is highly skilled and 
demands individual advice. It is less about large 
quantities and more about stocking and fast 
delivery of ready-to-connect items. The broad 
product and customer spectrum of this group is a 
particular challenge. 
 
Business partners/large-scale industry  
This customer group focuses on one project, 
whereby the partner, who does not necessarily 
come from the POS environment, is entrusted 
with the implementation of a larger project. 
We support our customers from product selection, 
quotation preparation and test installation 
through to the (often medium and long-term) 
rollout for the stores.A sophisticated product portfolio has the following 
objectives: The customer should be able to obtain 
all products from a broad delivery program from 
a single source. This strengthens the cooperation 
between distributor and reseller and offers our custo-
mers a highly efficient and cost-effective purchasing 
and service policy. 
 
Synergy: Resellers and distributors form a comple-
mentary team. This means that all individual requi-
rements can be met competently and completely - to 
everyone‘s satisfaction. 
The benchmark for our objectives is an appropriately 
diversified product range. 
 
Our product portfolio. 
High quality & comprehensive.
QUAD GmbH
Our Partners
and many more.

QUAD GmbH
Checkout Technology + Peripherals
No other product combines quality and design as 
strongly as our POS systems. For the end customer, 
the cash register is the central element in the POS 
- an essential success factor for every company. A 
modern POS system must not only be reliable and 
user-friendly, but also have an appealing design - 
both stationary and mobile. 
 
We know that our customers rely on a careful and 
future-proof product selection. That‘s why we work 
exclusively with leading, world-renowned manufac-
turers who guarantee the highest quality, innovation 
and long-term availability. 
 
Checkout technology - as flexible as your business.   
QUAD GmbH
Kiosk + Digital Signage
As individual as their possible applications. 
The flexible kiosk systems from Posiflex are used 
wherever information is made available and pro-
cessed directly. 
 
The simple, space-saving design fits perfectly into 
any environment. The well thought-out design 
enables easy maintenance - without dismantling or 
time-consuming unscrewing. 
 
With numerous options and a secure presence, 
kiosk systems enable a wide range of self-service 
applications. For example, with a cash manage-
ment solution or a receipt printer, the kiosk systems 
are ideal for use in system catering or retail. 
 
Intuitive and interactive use - stylish and 
stylish and modern packaging.
QUAD GmbH
Mounting Systems
Our innovative mounting systems enable space-sa-
ving and efficient integration of checkout monitors, 
payment terminals, digital signage displays, receipt 
printers and other retail IT. Thanks to the mix-and-
match connectivity, individual configurations can be 
created that are precisely tailored to the respective 
requirements. 
 
Whether stationary or mobile, for the operator or 
the self-service area - our mounting solutions offer 
maximum flexibility. Modular components make it 
possible to securely and ergonomically mount diffe-
rent devices, so that work processes are optimized 
and valuable space is used efficiently. 
 
Design your perfect solution -  
exactly as your company needs it.

QUAD GmbH
Cash Management
Cash loss not only describes the hard loss of cash 
due to incorrect returns or crime, but also inclu-
des the consequential costs of handling money in 
general: 
 
Cash management systems optimize the payment 
process and reduce errors when giving change. In 
addition, employees no longer have direct contact 
with cash, which significantly improves hygiene in 
the workplace. 
 
A cash management system is therefore ideal for 
use in bakeries, grocery stores, 
petrol stations, clothing stores, fast-food restau-
rants, bars, etc.
QUAD GmbH
Barcoding
In today‘s industry, barcoding is an indispensable 
technology that speeds up processes, reduces er-
rors and increases efficiency. By automatically cap-
turing data using barcodes or QR codes, barcoding 
enables seamless product traceability, more precise 
warehouse management and optimized logistics 
processes. 
 
Whether in production, quality control, warehou-
sing or shipping - barcoding ensures maximum 
transparency, minimizes manual input errors and 
improves the traceability of goods along the entire 
supply chain. It also forms the basis for data-based 
decisions that companies can use to optimize their 
processes and secure competitive advantages. 
 
Experience how barcoding can revolutionize your 
industrial processes - for more precision, speed and 
security.
QUAD GmbH
Label Printing
Label printing plays a crucial role in industrial pro-
duction, logistics and quality assurance. It inclu-
des the precise creation and marking of labels for 
products, packaging and stock. With robust printing 
technologies and customized solutions, Label Prin-
ting ensures complete traceability, efficient process 
control and compliance with legal requirements. 
 
Whether barcodes, QR codes or individual lay-
outs - modern systems ensure high print quality 
and adaptability to different materials and environ-
ments.  
 
Discover how label printing can improve your pro-
cesses.
QUAD GmbH
Handheld
Handhelds and tablets are powerful, portable de-
vices that have been specially developed for use in 
industrial environments. Thanks to their robust de-
sign, they can withstand extreme conditions such as 
shocks, dust, moisture and temperature fluctuations 
and enable reliable work wherever conventional 
devices reach their limits. 
 
Whether in logistics, warehouse management, 
production or field service - these mobile devices 
impress with their durability, long battery life and 
intuitive operation. They optimize work processes, 
reduce sources of error and increase productivity, 
making them an indispensable tool for Industry 4.0. 
 
Rely on powerful handheld technology and benefit 
from greater efficiency, mobility and future-proo-
fing.

QUAD GmbH
OEM
OEM refers to installable products for integra-
tion into existing systems and solutions. The OEM 
components are used, for example, in the areas of 
scanning and RFID - including in  
manufacturing processes, medical and laboratory 
technology, information terminals, reverse vending 
machines and ticket and access control systems. 
 
Our OEM team has been successfully positio-
ning itself worldwide for many years as a supplier 
of scanning and RFID modules from well-known 
manufacturers for installation in systems and pro-
ducts. With locations in Germany, France, Italy and 
the UK, we offer customized solutions that meet the 
highest standards of quality, reliability and innova-
tion. 
 
Thanks to our close cooperation with leading 
manufacturers, we can develop individual OEM 
concepts that are seamlessly integrated into your 
systems and make your processes more efficient.
QUAD GmbH
RFID
RFID (Radio-Frequency Identification) enables the 
contactless identification and tracking of goods 
of various sizes - from individual items such as 
clothing and medicines to pallets in logistics and 
vehicles at toll booths or veterinary microchips. 
 
Depending on the application, different radio 
frequency ranges are used, which differ in terms of 
range, speed and accuracy. The choice of suitable 
RFID technology depends largely on the size of the 
object, the required reading distance and the en-
vironmental conditions. 
 
RFID systems offer a powerful and efficient solution 
for automating processes, increasing security and 
optimizing inventory management.
QUAD GmbH
Smart Glasses
The technology of smart glasses opens up nume-
rous application possibilities in a wide range of 
areas. Augmented reality (AR) is increasingly being 
used in business, medicine, defence and the consu-
mer market to optimize processes, provide informa-
tion in real time and create new opportunities for 
interaction. 
 
The product portfolio includes head-mounted 
displays, wearable computing devices, OEM com-
ponents and advanced display engines that enable 
first-class visuals and immersive augmented reality 
experiences. 
 
Whether for hands-free work in industry, more 
precise diagnoses in medicine or interactive appli-
cations in retail, smart glasses improve efficiency, 
increase productivity and open up completely new 
perspectives for the digital workplace of the future.
QUAD GmbH
Machine Vision
Modern warehouse and logistics environments 
are under increasing pressure to adapt to rising 
customer demands and the rapid growth of e-
commerce. Companies must constantly optimize 
their processes to ensure greater speed, maximum 
accuracy and cost efficiency - without losing sight 
of user-friendliness. 
 
To meet these challenges, more and more compa-
nies are turning to automation technologies that 
make workflows smarter, more efficient and more 
scalable. 
 
Through the targeted use of these technologies, in-
ventory management, picking and shipping proces-
ses can be optimized and human error reduced to 
a minimum. The future of logistics lies in intelligent 
automation - actively shape the change.
QUAD GmbH
Our Services
Logistical planning/control of orders is a core task 
of the distributor. Our services cover all stages of a 
business relationship, from purchasing of a business 
relationship, from purchasing & product planning, 
quotations and the complete delivery service - also in 
the medium and long term. 
 
The post-sales area - in-warranty and out-of-warranty 
repairs - has a high structural value. 
 
We support you with any size of project right from the 
start and establish connections with partners whose 
solutions solutions enrich your offer to the customer.  
customer. 
 
These include industry solutions and 
on-site installation service. 
 
Further services on request:
• Purchasing advice with product & competitor infor-
mation
• Sales support in the project with 
customer appointments
• Logistical support with on-site installation service
• Preload + rollout service (store projects) for  
Operating system + merchandise management
• Complete solution with individually preconfigured  
peripherals and cabling
• Warranty service through own support
You have the request.
We offer the solution.
QUAD GmbH
Distribution + Consulting
Windmüllerstr. 30 
D-59557 Lippstadt
Phone: +49 2941 2801-0
E-Mail: info@quad.de
Web: www.quad.de

components are used, for example, in the areas of 
scanning and RFID - including in  
manufacturing processes, medical and laboratory 
technology, information terminals, reverse vending 
machines and ticket and access control systems. 
 
Our OEM team has been successfully positio-
ning itself worldwide for many years as a supplier 
of scanning and RFID modules from well-known 
manufacturers for installation in systems and pro-
ducts. With locations in Germany, France, Italy and 
the UK, we offer customized solutions that meet the 
highest standards of quality, reliability and innova-
tion. 
 
Thanks to our close cooperation with leading 
manufacturers, we can develop individual OEM 
concepts that are seamlessly integrated into your 
systems and make your processes more efficient.
QUAD GmbH
RFID
RFID (Radio-Frequency Identification) enables the 
contactless identification and tracking of goods 
of various sizes - from individual items such as 
clothing and medicines to pallets in logistics and 
vehicles at toll booths or veterinary microchips.

subject: Nachfrage Angebot Immobilienverwaltung | 1120 Wien, Schallergasse 35 | SMT-Immobilien
text:
Sehr geehrter Herr Covaciu,

 

vorab bedanken wir uns nochmals herzlich für Ihre Anfrage zur Immobilienverwaltung für die Liegenschaft 1120 Wien, Schallergasse 35.
